[SWS_LOG_00228] Argument separation in console output
⌈
When a message
contains more than one payload argument, any two payload arguments shall be sepa-
rated by a single space character (U+0020) in console output.
⌋
(RS_LT_00002)
Example: A log call such as:
mLog.LogInfo() << "speed" << 4.1 << "m/s";
will result in this output:
... speed
